info.title: Elan vital
info.description:
Celebrating the creative force, the impulse responsible for growth, prosperity, and change. A woman's life is constantly changing, and this collection,"Èlan Vital" by Skytten Couture, celebrates the creative force. Her quality of adapting to different circumstances is honored.

The intricate designs in the collection are nothing but the epitome of power and tranquility that she carries inside her heart. She deserves exquisite because she is one! Together, we celebrate our very precious woman, extravagance,rarity, and stellar attitude.

This collection,' Èlan Vital" by 'Skytten Couture,' promises luxury and opulence. Her aura of tranquility and mystique that she carries with elegance.

The designs are tailored to match her splendid and luscious ambiance.The colors chosen for this collection vary from subtle to bold, representing her moods.

She can be both breezy and fierce. The designs in this collection scream luxury and extravagance.

info.title: Into the Dawn
info.description:
As night gives way to morning and darkness subsides, hope, shrouded in first light, makes her presence known. Into the Dawn: Waad Aloqaili’s latest, breathtaking collection celebrates the boundless power of sistership. Co-Creative Directors Ahlam and Waad Aloqaili return to the image of the butterfly as a captivating motif for rebirth.
Finding inspiration in the deep spiritual bond between them, Into the Dawn is born of the unshakeable love and support between two women during times of darkness, and culminates in a kaleidoscopic celebration of their own sistership.
The collection of six exquisite dresses spans a joyous spectrum of jewel tones akin to a blossoming garden filled with butterflies. Elegant floor-skimming gowns cut from lustrous silks radiate in uplifting shades of amber, coral and turquoise while floods of diamantes and gemstones create streams of shimmering light.
The Creative Directors’ celebratory mood is seen elsewhere in shaping and adornment; asymmetrical and above-the-knee dresses exude playfulness while ostrich feathers and hand-embroidered butterflies ripple with the air as if ready to take flight.
Waad Aloqaili’s launch of Into the Dawn coincides with Sisters’ Day on August 6,2023, a day ordinarily reserved to commemorate our relationships with our female siblings. With this collection, Creative Directors Ahlam and Waad Aloqaili are extending the celebration beyond family ties or friendship. This is for our soul sisters.

products.title: FLOURISH Gown
products.body_html: With its slender silhouette and blush pink coloring, Flourish exudes timeless elegance. The gown is hand-crafted from crepe with a demure, high neckline and column shaping. It has a dramatic train cut from imitation silk satin, a scalloped hem and an intricately beaded duo of butterflies. This beautiful motif is woven throughout the collection to celebrate the unshakeable bond between soul sisters. A team of ten talented couturiers spend a total of 300 hours handcrafting this garment
tags: Pink evening dress for special occasions

info.title: Joy
info.description:
This season we have launched a stunning range of gowns that combine both striking modern love, and classic romance. The daring colours, flattering cuts and form fitting styles will make the decision of choosing just one gown from this collection even harder.

We want to see you be empowered to be your truest self as you step into your dream love story. The radiant yellows, blushing magenta, bold black and enchanting blues will see you radiate confidence, fun and elegance.

We have endeavoured to make each gown just as unique, feminine and fearless as you. The sparkled necklines, off shoulder styles, statement cut outs and dramatic skirts will be sure to turn heads and give you your main character moment.

Each gown has been carefully crafted, and expertly made, with no detail overlooked, as we know you deserve the absolute best on your day that is all about you. Live in the moment and embrace the free spirit you were born to be.

info.title: Out of the Chrysalis
info.description:
From the very first moments of meeting someone special, to the untold amazement you feel after a long wait; the marvelous feeling when you are at the pinnacle of happiness with butterflies fluttering in your stomach, when you are dazzled and experience the universe colored with clarity and harmony—we want to take you there.

Out of the Chrysalis: an exquisite new collection that empowers you to shine with lightness and grace, open to new possibilities. At Skytten Couture, this is what we call new energy.

Co-Creative Directors Ahlam and Waad Aloqaili looked to the turn of the Millennium for inspiration, opting for fluid fabrics and glistening adornment to evoke excitement and transformative energy.

Across the collection, georgette, tulle and satin form body-skimming and waisted cuts, with ruffles and feathers envisaging a butterfly fluttering its wings before its maiden flight.

A myriad of beads, sequins and crystals, which applied by hand, form delicate corollas or mimic the intricate scales of a butterfly’s incredible wings. As the wearer moves, the dress creates its own energy; the light dances and any nervousness or trepidation falls away. Everything is as it should be.

This is your moment. And the world awaits.

products.title: Harmony Gown
products.body_html:
A breathtaking entrance is guaranteed with this divine ballgown. An ode to the mesmerizing patterning of a butterfly, the dress is adorned with an exaggerated wing design formed from scores of shimmering beads. It's cut from satin with a tulle underskirt for lift and a smooth lining.

A team of ten talented couturiers spend a total of 300 hours handcrafting every element of this garment.

products.title: AURELLE GOWN
products.body_html:
This gown is crafted from soft tulle and defined by a structured mermaid silhouette shaped through dense hand embroidery. The neckline forms a shell-like contour, framed with clustered pearls that articulate the upper edge with sculptural clarity. Sequins, crystals, and beads are arranged in successive lines across the surface, generating controlled luminosity and visual rhythm. Along the sides, layered tulle cascades in formations inspired by the structure of fish scales, integrated seamlessly into the silhouette.

 

Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface mastery and structural precision.

products.title: AURORA GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless ball gown is crafted from silk satin and defined by a structured bodice with a sweetheart neckline that flows into a voluminous skirt with graceful presence. The silhouette is elevated by an intricate composition of hand-sewn beads, sequins, drills, crystals, pearls, and stones, creating a richly embellished surface with remarkable depth and luminosity.

 

Handcrafted by a team of seven to ten skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of execution, exceptional craftsmanship, and meticulous attention to detail.

products.title: AWAR GOWN
products.body_html:
This ball gown is constructed from silk satin in warm, sunlit tones and defined by a sculpted strapless bodice. The neckline forms a shell-like contour, fully hand-embroidered with sequins, crystals, and beads arranged in precise tonal gradations of yellow, apricot, and soft brown. The embroidery builds a contoured surface that defines the upper body with clarity. Below, the satin skirt opens from the waist into a balanced volume, allowing the material’s natural sheen to articulate movement.

 

Handcrafted by a team of six skilled couturiers over 700 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface mastery and structural precision.

products.title: AZUR GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless aquamarine ball gown is crafted from mikado silk and defined by a structured corseted bodice. The neckline follows a softly curved, wave-like line, delicately hand-embroidered with sequins and crystals along the upper edge. From the waist, the fabric opens into a full skirt with a clear, structured shape.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

In striking black, the Black Moment dress with the strapless bodice flowing into a beautiful gathered base extends to the ground leading into a classic fairytale train guaranteed to give you your princess moment.

products.title: DANAH GOWN
products.body_html:
With its mesmerizing seashell-inspired embellishment and striking off-the-shoulder silhouette, this long-sleeved gown aptly showcases the artistry and boundless creativity of couture. Luminous crepe forms a soft curve at the neckline before draping fluidly to the floor. The gown is adorned with an iridescent composition of hand-sewn beads, sequins, crystals, pearls, and stones, blending delicate shades of blush pink, aqua, opal, and ivory to evoke the luminous beauty of a seashell.

 

Handcrafted by a team of skilled couturiers over 300 hours, the gown embodies couture defined by exceptional craftsmanship, intricate surface artistry, and timeless elegance.

products.title: DIVINE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length ball gown is crafted from liquid satin in a deep plum tone and defined by a structured bodice and a full skirt. The bodice features a shell-inspired construction, executed through precise internal shaping and hand embroidery of pearls and sequins arranged in controlled vertical flow. The satin surface holds its form through the upper body before opening into volume from the waist, creating a balanced architectural silhouette.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by material control, precision of cut, and disciplined structure.

products.title: DRAGONFLIES GOWN
products.body_html: Dragonflies is a mesmerizing blend of opulence, elegance and artisanship. Soft satin is perfectly contoured to follow the natural curves of the body, creating a sensuously smooth silhouette. Ripples of beads, sequins and crystals in azure blue and teal cover every inch of the gown, mimicking the sinuous form of dragonfly wings. From the elaborate full-length embellishment to the figure-defining silhouette, every element of this gown is masterfully executed by skilled couturiers over the course of 900 hours.

products.title: DUNE GOWN
products.body_html:
This gown features a full skirt constructed from multiple layers of tulle, organized into repeated tiers with scalloped shell-shaped edges. The bodice is formed through two opposing shell structures, densely hand-embroidered with sequins, beads, crystals, and pearls arranged in precise tonal gradations of lilac, amber, and soft neutral hues. The embroidery extends across each tier in a continuous, symmetrical rhythm, visually unifying the bodice and skirt into a single composition.

 

The layered construction introduces depth while preserving clarity of silhouette and controlled luminosity. The piece reflects couture defined by surface mastery and structural precision.

products.title: DUR GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is built on a close, sculpted crepe silhouette that traces the body with restraint. Over the bodice, lustrous taffeta is shaped into fluid drapery forming shell-like contours. The taffeta continues seamlessly from the front toward the back, then descends to the floor as a single extended tail. Its scalloped edges follow an irregular outline, recalling the layered structure of fish scales while remaining refined and controlled.

 

Handcrafted by a team of skilled couturiers, the gown reflects couture defined by material continuity and balance.

products.title: Ellie Gown
products.body_html: This vibrant, orange mini dress is imbued with frivolity andspirit. It's crafted from Italian satin in a form-fitting cut with a single, asymmetric strap. Delicate 3D embroidered butterflies, linked together with waves of hand-sewn crystals, sequins and beadwork call to mind the unbreakable, spiritual bond between sisters. A team of ten talented couturiers spend a total of 400 hours handcrafting this garment.

products.title: Feathers Wedding Gown
products.body_html:
Wedding Dress by Elan Vital, Pre-Autumn 2022 Collection

 

A unique design with an exceptional feel, this feathers wedding gown by Skytten Couture is a masterpiece of elegance. A stunning and rare piece of wearable art off-white in color with silver detailing on top. The design creates a stunning silhouette while accenting your body's natural curves, making you feel and look unique. Absolutely gorgeous but highly comfortable to wear, this wedding dress features beautiful, intricate detailing. The bottom of the dress features a feather-adorned border, making it a statement look. This dress is an incredibly luxurious gown, made with incredible attention to detail. True beauty is subtle romance, which can only be appreciated when you see it on your body.

 

This piece was manual sewing over 63 days by 30 sewing and embroidery specialists, using ostrich feathers, crystals, stones, and several types of beads and silver and transparent sequins.

Tail length: 150 cm (you can choose puff size and dress length).

Veil length: 400 cm

Fabrics: several layers of four different types of Tulle, and Gorgeet.

This piece can be modified by special request, it takes 3 months to implement like changing the color, length, and puff.

products.title: GLIDE GOWN
products.body_html: Capturing an air of quiet dynamism and timeless grace, Glide is the culmination of over 700 hours of couture craftsmanship and masterful design. Echoing the brilliance of the dragonfly, reams of jewel-green crepe are expertly tailored by a team of artisans to form a fitted bodice and spliced mermaid skirt. Two straps, that tumble from the shoulder, feature elegant wing motifs composed of a myriad of beads, sequins and crystals.

products.title: GOLDEN DEW GOWN
products.body_html: Flooded with glistening beads, sequins and crystals, Golden Dew is an ode to the artistry of couture. Meticulously tailored to the contours of the body, the gown falls to the floor with a classic mermaid skirt and features elegant gloved sleeves. Drawing on powerful symbolism of the enigmatic dragonfly, the dress features a wing shaped cut-out at the waist, which extends to form a dramatic plunge neckline. Additional cut-outs at the back mirror this evocative motif. Skillful couturiers finesse every stitch, fold and cut over the course of 800 hours to ensure an impeccable finish.

products.title: LIORE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is defined by a commanding, fully hand-embroidered surface that shapes the identity of the piece. The high-neck bodice is worked with hand-cut mother-of-pearl elements, faceted crystals, and natural pearls, assembled to form a dense, luminous surface that captures and reflects light with clarity. The embroidery establishes the visual weight of the gown while articulating the upper body through precision.

 

From the bodice, fluid chiffon panels extend downward, opening the silhouette into movement. Handcrafted by seven skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown embodies couture defined by surface mastery, material discipline, and enduring presence beyond season and trend.

products.title: LONG SLEEVE WEDDING GOWN
products.body_html:
Wedding Dress by Elan Vital, Pre-Autumn 2022 Collection

This gown is absolutely exquisite and extremely rare. It is a full-length gown with incredibly luscious detailing taking its inspiration from the classic ball gown. It feels like you're glowing under the lights, while the long beautiful trail is perfect for adding more grace to the ensemble.

 

This piece was manual sewing over 63 days by 30 sewing and embroidery specialists, using crystals, stones, and several types of beads and silver, white and transparent sequins.

Tail length: 80 cm (available in different lengths, you can choose puff size and length)

Veil length: 400 cm. 

Fabrics: several layers of four different types of Tulle, and polyester.

This piece can be modified by special request, it takes 3 months to implement like changing the color, length, and puff.

products.title: MOONLIT GOWN
products.body_html: With streams of lustrous adornment and a slender silhouette, Moonlit is the epitome of timeless elegance. Thousands of hand-sewn sequins, beads and gems mimic the shimmering wings of the magnificent dragonfly—a powerful symbol of transformation and rebirth. Gossamer layers of georgette and tulle are skillfully hand-shaped to form a demure high neck, sensual mermaid skirt and billowing, wing-like cape. A team of consummate artisans craft every element of the design over the course of 800 hours.

products.title: MOTHER PEARL GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless, floor-length gown is defined by a straight column silhouette and a bodice constructed from hand-carved mother-of-pearl laminate. Each tile is cut, polished, and assembled to form a continuous, iridescent surface that reflects light through the natural properties of the material. The bodice establishes the visual identity and weight of the piece with clarity and precision.

 

From the waist, vertical strands of natural pearls and hand-set crystal droplets descend over chiffon, introducing controlled luminous movement in contrast to the structured upper form. Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by material mastery, precision, and permanence.

products.title: MYSTIC BLACK GOWN
products.body_html: This sublime couture gown exudes sophistication. Reams of black crepe, draped to perfection by skilled dressmakers, follow the natural curves of the body and finish in a dramatic mermaid train. Wing-shaped shoulder cut-outs and bejeweled gloved sleeves allude to the rarely seen wings of a dragonfly-an evocative motif that weaves throughout the collection, symbolizing rebirth and transformation. An exemplary team of ten talented couturiers pour their expertise, talent and passion into creating this exceptional design over the course of 300 hours.

products.title: NACRE GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless, floor-length gown is defined by a straight column silhouette and a fully hand-embroidered surface. The surface is entirely worked with hand-cut mother-of-pearl tiles, faceted crystals, and natural pearls, assembled into a dense, reflective field that captures and returns light with controlled intensity. The embroidery establishes the visual identity of the piece while maintaining a continuous vertical line.


A sheer tulle cape veil extends from the head and shoulders, introducing fluid movement in contrast to the structured silhouette. Handcrafted by a team of ten couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface mastery.

products.title: NACREOUS GOWN
products.body_html:
This short gown is defined by a sculpted bodice formed as two opposing shell shapes, immersed in pearls, and a precisely engineered structure through the hips that shapes the silhouette and stabilizes the line. Internally reinforced for definition, the surface is composed of real mother-of-pearl fragments hand-assembled into a luminous mosaic that responds to light with controlled brilliance, interspersed with thousands of crystals, natural pearls, and beads.

 

The hem is finished with suspended pearl drops, while a sheer veil adorned with crystal droplets completes the look. Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 900 hours, the piece reflects couture defined by material integrity, structural control, and surface precision.

products.title: NOIR GOWN
products.body_html: Noir is a remarkable full-length gown that blends faultless craftsmanship with understated elegance. The alluring off-the-shoulder neckline and exaggerated mermaid skirt are meticulously tailored from reams of black crepe, and adorned with dozens of shimmering beads, sequins and gemstones. Ostrich feathers trace the line of each sleeve-an allusion to the dragonfly as a metaphor for self-transformation. Ten talented dressmakers and artisans spend over 300 hours perfecting this magnificent creation.

products.title: OCEAN SOUL GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is executed in deep wine-toned tulle and defined by a fluid silhouette with a halter construction. Sheer panels drape from the shoulders, framing the body with controlled movement. The surface is hand-embroidered with sequins, beads, and crystals arranged into marine motifs, including corals, shells, and starfish. Subtle accents of mauve, blue, and rose emerge through the embroidery, creating depth against the dark base.

 

Handcrafted by a team of nine skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision and layered execution.

products.title: Oceanid Gown
products.body_html:
A mermaid-inspired dress designed with optical illusion pleats creates the illusion of a gossamer fabric floating around your body. The neckline is accentuated by a cape. The cape symbolizes the kiss before you step into the sea.

 

This piece was manual sewing over 42 days by sewing and 15embroidery, using crystal, stones, and several types of beads and sequins.

Fabrics Used: Soft Tulle and Georgette.

Tail length: 35 cm.

This piece can be modified by special request, it takes 3 months to implement like changing the color, length, puff, or adding sleeves.

products.title: ONDINE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from soft tulle, shaped through precise laser cutting to define the silhouette with clarity. The design follows the body in a structured line before widening at the hem into a balanced mermaid form. Layered tulle panels introduce visible depth and surface texture while maintaining controlled, fluid movement. A pronounced vertical construction runs through the piece, establishing a refined balance between structure and lightness.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by technical precision and material control.

products.title: OPAL GOWN
products.body_html: Inspired by the purity and strength of the lotus flower, this breathtaking creation demonstrates the beauty of simplicity. Draped to perfection in a timeless ballgown silhouette, Opal fits seamlessly on the body with a form-fitting bodice that blossoms into an elegant full skirt. Pristine ivory taffeta, hand-sculpted by a dedicated team of couturiers, adorn the hip-line in perfect symmetry. A team of skilled dressmakers pour hundreds of hours of meticulous craftsmanship into the creation of this unforgettable gown.

products.title: PEARLETTE GOWN
products.body_html:
This couture look is composed of a floor-length crepe skirt and a delicately hand-embroidered cropped top. The top is worked with crystals, sequins, beads, and pearls arranged in natural shell-inspired gradations, forming a luminous surface that defines the upper body with clarity. The skirt falls in a clean, elongated line, maintaining structure through restraint.

The look is completed by a sculptural three-dimensional shell element, crafted from liquid taffeta and embroidered with natural pearls. Attached to the body, it wraps around the arm and extends to the floor as an integral structural component of the design. 


Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 700 hours, the piece reflects couture defined by surface mastery and sculptural construction.

products.title: PEARLY GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from sheer ivory dentelle, featuring hand-embroidered detailing integrated into the surface. From the neckline, vertical strands of natural pearl fringes extend across the gown, introducing movement that becomes more pronounced with each step. The pearls interact with the transparency of the lace, creating a layered visual rhythm.

 

Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 900 hours, the gown reflects couture built on material expression, precision, and a considered approach to transparency.

products.title: PRIMROSE GOWN
products.body_html: Named after the delicate spring flower, Primrose is equally demure and spectacular. Lengths of hazy pink taffeta, meticulously sculpted by accomplished dressmakers, form an enchanting strapless ballgown silhouette. The waistline is defined by elegant folds, which replicate the sinuous form of petals, a motif that reappears as undulations in the softly gathered skirt. A team of talented dressmakers, each one wholly devoted to the craft and artistry of couture, spend hundreds of hours creating this unforgettable gown.

products.title: REVERIE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from crepe in a soft blush pink tone, defined by a fluid silhouette layered with soft tulle. The design unfolds in tiered levels, each edged with delicate hand embroidery arranged in subtle gradations of purple and blue. The embellishment remains concentrated along the hems, creating a shifting shimmer that moves in soft, wave-like rhythms with each step, allowing the layered tulle to move freely.

 

Handcrafted by a team of six skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by lightness, precision, and controlled motion.

products.title: ROSALINE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length, close-fitting gown is crafted from sheer tulle and chiffon in a soft blush pink tone, defined by an elongated silhouette that follows the body with lightness. The surface is hand-embroidered with sequins, crystals, and natural coral beads, arranged in a controlled gradation that reflects light across shell-like forms. The skirt is composed of layered sheer chiffon panels that fall into a mermaid silhouette, with overlapping side formations evoking the structure of fish scales.

 

Handcrafted by a team of nine skilled couturiers over 1,000 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision.

products.title: ROSE PETAL GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless gown is crafted from soft satin and constructed through hundreds of hand-embroidered shell forms. Each shell is individually built with thousands of beads, sequins, crystals, and pearls arranged in precise tonal gradations across the surface. The embroidery is shaped to create a contoured relief with subtle raised ridges that echo the natural structure of real shells. An irregular scalloped neckline and hemline follow the outline of the shell forms، reinforcing the sculptural construction.

 

Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by extreme handwork and precision.

products.title: Roselle GOWN
products.body_html: Roselle is a delicate blend of striking design, timeless elegance and couture flair. This halterneck gown is finely tailored from luminous satin in a svelte ankle-length cut finishing with a scalloped  hem. Extending from the waist is an elaborate gathered train, its delicate folds meticulously shaped and stitched by hand to mimic the soft curves of petals. This recurring floral motif, which is seen throughout the collection as a symbol of resilience and renewal, is replicated here in waves of glistening flower motifs, which adorn the lower skirt and train. Every element of this gown is  handcrafted by a team of talented couturiers, who devote over 300 hours to its creation.

products.title: SAND WHISPER GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from soft tulle in a warm yellow tone, shaped through an elongated, fluid silhouette. An asymmetric neckline is formed by fine draped pleats that descend across the body, creating a continuous line of movement. Delicate hand embroidery of sequins, beads, and natural stones is applied in controlled placements, tracing the form without interrupting its flow. The skirt opens subtly toward the hem, allowing lightness and motion to define the finish.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours.

products.title: SEAMIST GOWN
products.body_html:
This couture ensemble is composed of a structured crepe top and a fluid crepe skirt in an butter yellow tone. The upper piece is defined by a corseted construction and a fully hand-embroidered surface of beads, sequins, and crystals arranged in soft aqua gradations.

 

The skirt extends in mermaid cut. A sheer aqua tulle veil, executed as a separate element, drapes over the arms and head. Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the ensemble reflects couture defined by precision and restraint.

products.title: SEAWISP GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length halter gown is crafted from lightweight aquamarine crepe. Sophisticated hand embroidery of sequins and beads is arranged in radiating lines from the neckline and waist, establishing a clear visual rhythm across the body. From the waist, elongated handmade beaded fringe extends over the skirt, creating a luminous, continuous movement that becomes more pronounced with each step.

 

Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision, controlled motion, and material discipline.

products.title: SHELLÉ GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is executed in a deep wine-toned crepe base, shaped into a close, controlled silhouette. The neckline is sculpted into a shell-inspired form, delicately hand-embroidered with pearls and sequins that define the upper structure with quiet precision. Around the hip, liquid satin is wrapped in measured drapery, before extending seamlessly into a long, flowing tail that reinforces the sense of movement and balance.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 450 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by clarity of form, material control, and restrained elegance.

products.title: SIREN GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length ball gown is constructed from layered fine tulle, creating structured volume through lightness. The bodice forms a shell-shaped motif, executed with dense hand embroidery of crystals, sequins, beads, and pearls arranged in precise radiating lines that extend downward across the skirt. Soft tonal transitions of ivory, pink, and pale blue enhance depth within the embroidery.

 

A separately embroidered bolero frames the shoulders, echoing the same embroidery language. Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision.

products.title: SOLAR GOWN
products.body_html:
This gown is crafted from satin and defined by a sculpted, shell-inspired mermaid silhouette. The surface is fully hand-embroidered with sequins, beads, crystals, and pearls, arranged through a layered composition that begins with paired shell forms at the upper and lower body before unfolding into a precise radiating pattern. Tonal variations of lilac, amber, aquamarine, and sand-inflected hues are integrated within the embroidery, referencing shell surfaces and marine elements with controlled luminosity. The construction emphasizes clarity of form and disciplined surface balance.

 

Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,500 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by intensive handwork and structural precision.

Ateamoftentalented couturiers spend a total of 450 hours handcrafting every element of this garment.

products.body_html:

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 500 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

products.title: ِAngelic Wedding Gown
products.body_html:
kyttencouture Couture Pre-Fall 2022 Èlan Vital collection.

This ensemble wears A LOT of white. The layered ruffles are ample and floaty. The dress is fitted around the waist, giving an exquisite and flattering shape. The aesthetic of the gown celebrates the label's inherent feminine perspective. A nod to those who offer expression through intricate designs and patterns. The square neckline is distinguished with detailed silver sequins and Czech stone detailing, while the shimmer adds an exquisite element to the collection.

This piece was manual sewing  over 63 days by 30 sewing and embroidery specialists, using ostrich feathers, crystals, stones, and several types of beads and silver, white and transparent  sequins

info.title: VEIL OF RENEWAL
info.description:
WAAD ALOQAILI COUTURE SPRING/SUMMER 2025

 

Beneath the surface, a quiet yet powerful force stirs—the promise of transformation.

Veil of Renewal embarks on a journey of becoming, where the fleeting dragonfly and the resilient lotus, rising from murky waters, embody the delicate balance between vulnerability and strength. Beauty emerges in the most unexpected places, where fragility holds the power of renewal.

Meticulously handcrafted gowns bloom with intricate hand embroidery, delicate floral appliqué, and avant-garde fabric manipulation techniques. Ethereal hues of emerald green, burnished gold, blush pink, and muted ivory flow through veiled silhouettes, revealing a quiet radiance with every movement.

Each piece is a testament to resilience where transformation is not just seen but felt.

In partnership with the Zahra Breast Cancer Association, proceeds from Veil of Renewal will support breast cancer awareness, honoring the courage and fortitude of women on their journeys of renewal.

products.title: ALLURE GOWN
products.body_html: Allure is a luminous creation inspired by the remarkable lotus flower-an enduring symbol of resilience and renewal. The timeless silhouette is composed of delicate layers of crepe, georgette and tulle, overlaid with an exquisite floral design. Glistening petals of rose pink and cornflower blue cover the gown; every bead, sequin, crystal and gemstone meticulously hand-stitched in place. From the first cut of fabric to the last stitch, every element of the gown is considered and precise; a team of ten dedicate around 900 hours to its creation.

products.title: Emeralds GOWN
products.body_html: Emeralds is a striking mermaid gown that exudes sophistication and modern femininity. Crafted from flowing emerald-green crepe, the dress is expertly tailored to trace the body’s silhouette, cascading into a dramatic floor-length skirt. A glistening dragonfly, formed from a myriad of beads, sequins and crystals, rests delicately on the gown, symbolizing transformation and renewal. Every intricate detail testifies to the dedication of Waad Aloqaili couturiers who invest 350 hours to bring this masterpiece to life.

products.title: GLIDE GOWN
products.body_html: Capturing an air of quiet dynamism and timeless grace, Glide is the culmination of over 700 hours of couture craftsmanship and masterful design. Echoing the brilliance of the dragonfly, reams of jewel-green crepe are expertly tailored by a team of artisans to form a fitted bodice and spliced mermaid skirt. Two straps, that tumble from the shoulder, feature elegant wing motifs composed of a myriad of beads, sequins and crystals.

products.title: Lune GOWN
products.body_html: A luminous creation designed in partnership with Zahra Breast Cancer Association, Lune radiates powerful femininity and  sophistication. The sylphlike silhouette is formed from lustrous ivory crepe, which is sculpted at the neckline with two exquisite lotuses. The sensitivity and beauty of the design not only testifies to the craftsmanship and vision of Waad Aloqaili, but serves as a fitting tribute to women throughout the world living with breast cancer.

products.title: Garden of delight GOWN
products.body_html: Created in partnership with Zahra Breast Cancer Association,Garden of Delight emanates timeless elegance and feminine strength. Luminous silks and tulle are expertly tailored to form a billowing skirt and strapless bodice, shaped at the neckline with two lotus flowers that symbolize renewal and purity. Lustrous threads, gemstones, sequins, and beads enrich the floral design, catching the light with every movement. A team of artisans dedicate over 400 hours to perfect the gown’s ageless ballgown silhouette and exquisite adornment.

products.title: MOONLIT GOWN
products.body_html: With streams of lustrous adornment and a slender silhouette, Moonlit is the epitome of timeless elegance. Thousands of hand-sewn sequins, beads and gems mimic the shimmering wings of the magnificent dragonfly—a powerful symbol of transformation and rebirth. Gossamer layers of georgette and tulle are skillfully hand-shaped to form a demure high neck, sensual mermaid skirt and billowing, wing-like cape. A team of consummate artisans craft every element of the design over the course of 800 hours.

products.title: GOLDEN DEW GOWN
products.body_html: Flooded with glistening beads, sequins and crystals, Golden Dew is an ode to the artistry of couture. Meticulously tailored to the contours of the body, the gown falls to the floor with a classic mermaid skirt and features elegant gloved sleeves. Drawing on powerful symbolism of the enigmatic dragonfly, the dress features a wing shaped cut-out at the waist, which extends to form a dramatic plunge neckline. Additional cut-outs at the back mirror this evocative motif. Skillful couturiers finesse every stitch, fold and cut over the course of 800 hours to ensure an impeccable finish.

products.title: Fleur GOWN
products.body_html: A luminous creation designed in partnership with Zahra Breast Cancer Association, Lune radiates powerful femininity and  sophistication. The sylphlike silhouette is formed from lustrous ivory crepe, which is sculpted at the neckline with two exquisite lotuses. The sensitivity and beauty of the design not only testifies to the craftsmanship and vision of Waad Aloqaili, but serves as a fitting tribute to women throughout the world living with breast cancer.

products.title: Roselle GOWN
products.body_html: Roselle is a delicate blend of striking design, timeless elegance and couture flair. This halterneck gown is finely tailored from luminous satin in a svelte ankle-length cut finishing with a scalloped  hem. Extending from the waist is an elaborate gathered train, its delicate folds meticulously shaped and stitched by hand to mimic the soft curves of petals. This recurring floral motif, which is seen throughout the collection as a symbol of resilience and renewal, is replicated here in waves of glistening flower motifs, which adorn the lower skirt and train. Every element of this gown is  handcrafted by a team of talented couturiers, who devote over 300 hours to its creation.

products.body_html: This sublime couture gown exudes sophistication. Reams of black crepe, draped to perfection by skilled dressmakers, follow the natural curves of the body and finish in a dramatic mermaid train. Wing-shaped shoulder cut-outs and bejeweled gloved sleeves allude to the rarely seen wings of a dragonfly-an evocative motif that weaves throughout the collection, symbolizing rebirth and transformation. An exemplary team of ten talented couturiers pour their expertise, talent and passion into creating this exceptional design over the course of 300 hours.

products.body_html: Noir is a remarkable full-length gown that blends faultless craftsmanship with understated elegance. The alluring off-the-shoulder neckline and exaggerated mermaid skirt are meticulously tailored from reams of black crepe, and adorned with dozens of shimmering beads, sequins and gemstones. Ostrich feathers trace the line of each sleeve-an allusion to the dragonfly as a metaphor for self-transformation. Ten talented dressmakers and artisans spend over 300 hours perfecting this magnificent creation.

Lustrous satin, chiffon and tulle are carefully manipulated by hand to form delicate, undulating folds that gently embrace the figure and stream to the floor, evoking the organic, sinuous form of flowers. Beads, sequins and crystals, each one meticulously sewn by hand adorn each fine pleat, creating a perpetual shimmer. A team of ten talented couturiers spend a total of 300 hours handcrafting every contour and artistic element of this captivating creation.

info.title: Yamal
info.description:
WAAD ALOQAILI COUTURE SPRING/SUMMER 2026

 

The Rhythm of the Sea

 

Yamal unfolds as a dialogue between the sea and the soul, rooted in Saudi Arabia’s maritime legacy.
Drawn from the chant “Ya Mal” — once used by pearl divers to unify effort and endurance — the collection transforms a rhythm of survival into a contemporary couture language of resilience and belonging.

 

The collection traces the diver’s journey from shore to depth, and back to light. Silhouettes move with controlled fluidity: chiffons and liquid satins balanced by sculpted corsetry, nacre elements, and shell-inspired forms, where softness and strength exist in deliberate tension.

 

The palette mirrors this progression — pearlescent ivory, luminous sea blues, deep oceanic tones, and warm sandy hues — reflecting the shifting light beneath the surface.

 

At its core, Yamal treats craftsmanship as architecture. Hand-embroidered pearls and crystals, mother-of-pearl, and laser-cut shell motifs bridge tradition with innovation, guided by precision and restraint.

 

More than a collection, Yamal is a continuum — a reflection of Saudi identity in motion, where heritage evolves through intention and craftsmanship becomes continuity.

products.title: NACRE GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless, floor-length gown is defined by a straight column silhouette and a fully hand-embroidered surface. The surface is entirely worked with hand-cut mother-of-pearl tiles, faceted crystals, and natural pearls, assembled into a dense, reflective field that captures and returns light with controlled intensity. The embroidery establishes the visual identity of the piece while maintaining a continuous vertical line.


A sheer tulle cape veil extends from the head and shoulders, introducing fluid movement in contrast to the structured silhouette. Handcrafted by a team of ten couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface mastery.

products.title: LIORE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is defined by a commanding, fully hand-embroidered surface that shapes the identity of the piece. The high-neck bodice is worked with hand-cut mother-of-pearl elements, faceted crystals, and natural pearls, assembled to form a dense, luminous surface that captures and reflects light with clarity. The embroidery establishes the visual weight of the gown while articulating the upper body through precision.

 

From the bodice, fluid chiffon panels extend downward, opening the silhouette into movement. Handcrafted by seven skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown embodies couture defined by surface mastery, material discipline, and enduring presence beyond season and trend.

products.title: MOTHER PEARL GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless, floor-length gown is defined by a straight column silhouette and a bodice constructed from hand-carved mother-of-pearl laminate. Each tile is cut, polished, and assembled to form a continuous, iridescent surface that reflects light through the natural properties of the material. The bodice establishes the visual identity and weight of the piece with clarity and precision.

 

From the waist, vertical strands of natural pearls and hand-set crystal droplets descend over chiffon, introducing controlled luminous movement in contrast to the structured upper form. Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by material mastery, precision, and permanence.

products.title: PEARLY GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from sheer ivory dentelle, featuring hand-embroidered detailing integrated into the surface. From the neckline, vertical strands of natural pearl fringes extend across the gown, introducing movement that becomes more pronounced with each step. The pearls interact with the transparency of the lace, creating a layered visual rhythm.

 

Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 900 hours, the gown reflects couture built on material expression, precision, and a considered approach to transparency.

products.title: DANAH GOWN
products.body_html:
With its mesmerizing seashell-inspired embellishment and striking off-the-shoulder silhouette, this long-sleeved gown aptly showcases the artistry and boundless creativity of couture. Luminous crepe forms a soft curve at the neckline before draping fluidly to the floor. The gown is adorned with an iridescent composition of hand-sewn beads, sequins, crystals, pearls, and stones, blending delicate shades of blush pink, aqua, opal, and ivory to evoke the luminous beauty of a seashell.

 

Handcrafted by a team of skilled couturiers over 300 hours, the gown embodies couture defined by exceptional craftsmanship, intricate surface artistry, and timeless elegance.

products.title: SIREN GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length ball gown is constructed from layered fine tulle, creating structured volume through lightness. The bodice forms a shell-shaped motif, executed with dense hand embroidery of crystals, sequins, beads, and pearls arranged in precise radiating lines that extend downward across the skirt. Soft tonal transitions of ivory, pink, and pale blue enhance depth within the embroidery.

 

A separately embroidered bolero frames the shoulders, echoing the same embroidery language. Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision.

products.title: SEAWISP GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length halter gown is crafted from lightweight aquamarine crepe. Sophisticated hand embroidery of sequins and beads is arranged in radiating lines from the neckline and waist, establishing a clear visual rhythm across the body. From the waist, elongated handmade beaded fringe extends over the skirt, creating a luminous, continuous movement that becomes more pronounced with each step.

 

Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision, controlled motion, and material discipline.

products.title: REVERIE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from crepe in a soft blush pink tone, defined by a fluid silhouette layered with soft tulle. The design unfolds in tiered levels, each edged with delicate hand embroidery arranged in subtle gradations of purple and blue. The embellishment remains concentrated along the hems, creating a shifting shimmer that moves in soft, wave-like rhythms with each step, allowing the layered tulle to move freely.

 

Handcrafted by a team of six skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by lightness, precision, and controlled motion.

products.title: YAMM GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length aquamarine gown is crafted from finely worked dentelle and defined by a fitted, elongated silhouette. The off-shoulder neckline opens the upper frame, while the long sleeves are integrated into the lace structure, extending the line of the body. The transparency of the dentelle allows the embroidery to remain visually present across the surface.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision, disciplined execution, and balanced proportion.

products.title: TIDAL GOWN
products.body_html:
This aquamarine gown is crafted from mikado silk and defined by a structured corseted bodice that shapes the silhouette with clarity. The neckline follows a shell-like curve, delicately hand-embroidered with pearls, sequins, and crystals along the upper edge. A draped twist at the hip introduces controlled movement, from which the fabric extends into a clean column skirt finished with a soft trailing train.

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 500 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

products.title: WAVELET GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless aquamarine ball gown is crafted from mikado silk and defined by a structured corseted bodice. The neckline follows a softly curved, wave-like line, delicately hand-embroidered with sequins and crystals along the upper edge. From the waist, the fabric opens into a full skirt with a clear, structured shape.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

products.title: AZUR GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless aquamarine ball gown is crafted from mikado silk and defined by a structured corseted bodice. The neckline follows a softly curved, wave-like line, delicately hand-embroidered with sequins and crystals along the upper edge. From the waist, the fabric opens into a full skirt with a clear, structured shape.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

products.title: AURORA GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless ball gown is crafted from silk satin and defined by a structured bodice with a sweetheart neckline that flows into a voluminous skirt with graceful presence. The silhouette is elevated by an intricate composition of hand-sewn beads, sequins, drills, crystals, pearls, and stones, creating a richly embellished surface with remarkable depth and luminosity.

 

Handcrafted by a team of seven to ten skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of execution, exceptional craftsmanship, and meticulous attention to detail.

products.title: PEARLETTE GOWN
products.body_html:
This couture look is composed of a floor-length crepe skirt and a delicately hand-embroidered cropped top. The top is worked with crystals, sequins, beads, and pearls arranged in natural shell-inspired gradations, forming a luminous surface that defines the upper body with clarity. The skirt falls in a clean, elongated line, maintaining structure through restraint.

The look is completed by a sculptural three-dimensional shell element, crafted from liquid taffeta and embroidered with natural pearls. Attached to the body, it wraps around the arm and extends to the floor as an integral structural component of the design. 


Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 700 hours, the piece reflects couture defined by surface mastery and sculptural construction.

products.title: LUSTRE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length couture look is composed of a structured corset and a fluid crepe skirt. The corset is shaped with fine pleating in a soft aqua tone, forming a shell-like structure executed in tulle and reinforced through hand embroidery. Sequins, beads, and crystals are applied in controlled gradations of turquoise and lilac, creating a concentrated surface sheen along the bodice.

 

The crepe skirt is constructed from elongated ivory panels that open vertically, handcrafted by a team of six skilled couturiers over 650 hours, the piece reflects couture defined by precision, surface control, and sculptural balance.

products.title: SEAMIST GOWN
products.body_html:
This couture ensemble is composed of a structured crepe top and a fluid crepe skirt in an butter yellow tone. The upper piece is defined by a corseted construction and a fully hand-embroidered surface of beads, sequins, and crystals arranged in soft aqua gradations.

 

The skirt extends in mermaid cut. A sheer aqua tulle veil, executed as a separate element, drapes over the arms and head. Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the ensemble reflects couture defined by precision and restraint.

products.title: ONDINE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from soft tulle, shaped through precise laser cutting to define the silhouette with clarity. The design follows the body in a structured line before widening at the hem into a balanced mermaid form. Layered tulle panels introduce visible depth and surface texture while maintaining controlled, fluid movement. A pronounced vertical construction runs through the piece, establishing a refined balance between structure and lightness.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by technical precision and material control.

products.title: OCEAN SOUL GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is executed in deep wine-toned tulle and defined by a fluid silhouette with a halter construction. Sheer panels drape from the shoulders, framing the body with controlled movement. The surface is hand-embroidered with sequins, beads, and crystals arranged into marine motifs, including corals, shells, and starfish. Subtle accents of mauve, blue, and rose emerge through the embroidery, creating depth against the dark base.

 

Handcrafted by a team of nine skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision and layered execution.

products.title: DIVINE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length ball gown is crafted from liquid satin in a deep plum tone and defined by a structured bodice and a full skirt. The bodice features a shell-inspired construction, executed through precise internal shaping and hand embroidery of pearls and sequins arranged in controlled vertical flow. The satin surface holds its form through the upper body before opening into volume from the waist, creating a balanced architectural silhouette.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by material control, precision of cut, and disciplined structure.

products.title: DUR GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is built on a close, sculpted crepe silhouette that traces the body with restraint. Over the bodice, lustrous taffeta is shaped into fluid drapery forming shell-like contours. The taffeta continues seamlessly from the front toward the back, then descends to the floor as a single extended tail. Its scalloped edges follow an irregular outline, recalling the layered structure of fish scales while remaining refined and controlled.

 

Handcrafted by a team of skilled couturiers, the gown reflects couture defined by material continuity and balance.

products.title: SHELLÉ GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is executed in a deep wine-toned crepe base, shaped into a close, controlled silhouette. The neckline is sculpted into a shell-inspired form, delicately hand-embroidered with pearls and sequins that define the upper structure with quiet precision. Around the hip, liquid satin is wrapped in measured drapery, before extending seamlessly into a long, flowing tail that reinforces the sense of movement and balance.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 450 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by clarity of form, material control, and restrained elegance.

products.title: ROSE PETAL GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless gown is crafted from soft satin and constructed through hundreds of hand-embroidered shell forms. Each shell is individually built with thousands of beads, sequins, crystals, and pearls arranged in precise tonal gradations across the surface. The embroidery is shaped to create a contoured relief with subtle raised ridges that echo the natural structure of real shells. An irregular scalloped neckline and hemline follow the outline of the shell forms، reinforcing the sculptural construction.

 

Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by extreme handwork and precision.

products.title: ROSALINE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length, close-fitting gown is crafted from sheer tulle and chiffon in a soft blush pink tone, defined by an elongated silhouette that follows the body with lightness. The surface is hand-embroidered with sequins, crystals, and natural coral beads, arranged in a controlled gradation that reflects light across shell-like forms. The skirt is composed of layered sheer chiffon panels that fall into a mermaid silhouette, with overlapping side formations evoking the structure of fish scales.

 

Handcrafted by a team of nine skilled couturiers over 1,000 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision.

products.title: AWAR GOWN
products.body_html:
This ball gown is constructed from silk satin in warm, sunlit tones and defined by a sculpted strapless bodice. The neckline forms a shell-like contour, fully hand-embroidered with sequins, crystals, and beads arranged in precise tonal gradations of yellow, apricot, and soft brown. The embroidery builds a contoured surface that defines the upper body with clarity. Below, the satin skirt opens from the waist into a balanced volume, allowing the material’s natural sheen to articulate movement.

 

Handcrafted by a team of six skilled couturiers over 700 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface mastery and structural precision.

products.title: SAND WHISPER GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from soft tulle in a warm yellow tone, shaped through an elongated, fluid silhouette. An asymmetric neckline is formed by fine draped pleats that descend across the body, creating a continuous line of movement. Delicate hand embroidery of sequins, beads, and natural stones is applied in controlled placements, tracing the form without interrupting its flow. The skirt opens subtly toward the hem, allowing lightness and motion to define the finish.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours.

products.title: SOLAR GOWN
products.body_html:
This gown is crafted from satin and defined by a sculpted, shell-inspired mermaid silhouette. The surface is fully hand-embroidered with sequins, beads, crystals, and pearls, arranged through a layered composition that begins with paired shell forms at the upper and lower body before unfolding into a precise radiating pattern. Tonal variations of lilac, amber, aquamarine, and sand-inflected hues are integrated within the embroidery, referencing shell surfaces and marine elements with controlled luminosity. The construction emphasizes clarity of form and disciplined surface balance.

 

Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,500 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by intensive handwork and structural precision.

products.title: DUNE GOWN
products.body_html:
This gown features a full skirt constructed from multiple layers of tulle, organized into repeated tiers with scalloped shell-shaped edges. The bodice is formed through two opposing shell structures, densely hand-embroidered with sequins, beads, crystals, and pearls arranged in precise tonal gradations of lilac, amber, and soft neutral hues. The embroidery extends across each tier in a continuous, symmetrical rhythm, visually unifying the bodice and skirt into a single composition.

 

The layered construction introduces depth while preserving clarity of silhouette and controlled luminosity. The piece reflects couture defined by surface mastery and structural precision.

products.title: NACREOUS GOWN
products.body_html:
This short gown is defined by a sculpted bodice formed as two opposing shell shapes, immersed in pearls, and a precisely engineered structure through the hips that shapes the silhouette and stabilizes the line. Internally reinforced for definition, the surface is composed of real mother-of-pearl fragments hand-assembled into a luminous mosaic that responds to light with controlled brilliance, interspersed with thousands of crystals, natural pearls, and beads.

 

The hem is finished with suspended pearl drops, while a sheer veil adorned with crystal droplets completes the look. Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 900 hours, the piece reflects couture defined by material integrity, structural control, and surface precision.

products.title: AURELLE GOWN
products.body_html:
This gown is crafted from soft tulle and defined by a structured mermaid silhouette shaped through dense hand embroidery. The neckline forms a shell-like contour, framed with clustered pearls that articulate the upper edge with sculptural clarity. Sequins, crystals, and beads are arranged in successive lines across the surface, generating controlled luminosity and visual rhythm. Along the sides, layered tulle cascades in formations inspired by the structure of fish scales, integrated seamlessly into the silhouette.

 

Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface mastery and structural precision.

products.title: AURORA GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless ball gown is crafted from silk satin and defined by a structured bodice with a sweetheart neckline that flows into a voluminous skirt with graceful presence. The silhouette is elevated by an intricate composition of hand-sewn beads, sequins, drills, crystals, pearls, and stones, creating a richly embellished surface with remarkable depth and luminosity.

 

Handcrafted by a team of seven to ten skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of execution, exceptional craftsmanship, and meticulous attention to detail.

products.title: DANAH GOWN
products.body_html:
With its mesmerizing seashell-inspired embellishment and striking off-the-shoulder silhouette, this long-sleeved gown aptly showcases the artistry and boundless creativity of couture. Luminous crepe forms a soft curve at the neckline before draping fluidly to the floor. The gown is adorned with an iridescent composition of hand-sewn beads, sequins, crystals, pearls, and stones, blending delicate shades of blush pink, aqua, opal, and ivory to evoke the luminous beauty of a seashell.

 

Handcrafted by a team of skilled couturiers over 300 hours, the gown embodies couture defined by exceptional craftsmanship, intricate surface artistry, and timeless elegance.

products.title: AZUR GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless aquamarine ball gown is crafted from mikado silk and defined by a structured corseted bodice. The neckline follows a softly curved, wave-like line, delicately hand-embroidered with sequins and crystals along the upper edge. From the waist, the fabric opens into a full skirt with a clear, structured shape.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

products.title: DIVINE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length ball gown is crafted from liquid satin in a deep plum tone and defined by a structured bodice and a full skirt. The bodice features a shell-inspired construction, executed through precise internal shaping and hand embroidery of pearls and sequins arranged in controlled vertical flow. The satin surface holds its form through the upper body before opening into volume from the waist, creating a balanced architectural silhouette.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by material control, precision of cut, and disciplined structure.

The taffeta continues seamlessly from the front toward the back, then descends to the floor as a single extended tail. Its scalloped edges follow an irregular outline, recalling the layered structure of fish scales while remaining refined and controlled.

products.title: OCEAN SOUL GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is executed in deep wine-toned tulle and defined by a fluid silhouette with a halter construction. Sheer panels drape from the shoulders, framing the body with controlled movement. The surface is hand-embroidered with sequins, beads, and crystals arranged into marine motifs, including corals, shells, and starfish. Subtle accents of mauve, blue, and rose emerge through the embroidery, creating depth against the dark base.

 

Handcrafted by a team of nine skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision and layered execution.

products.title: ONDINE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from soft tulle, shaped through precise laser cutting to define the silhouette with clarity. The design follows the body in a structured line before widening at the hem into a balanced mermaid form. Layered tulle panels introduce visible depth and surface texture while maintaining controlled, fluid movement. A pronounced vertical construction runs through the piece, establishing a refined balance between structure and lightness.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by technical precision and material control.

products.title: SEAMIST GOWN
products.body_html:
This couture ensemble is composed of a structured crepe top and a fluid crepe skirt in an butter yellow tone. The upper piece is defined by a corseted construction and a fully hand-embroidered surface of beads, sequins, and crystals arranged in soft aqua gradations.

 

The skirt extends in mermaid cut. A sheer aqua tulle veil, executed as a separate element, drapes over the arms and head. Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 550 hours, the ensemble reflects couture defined by precision and restraint.

products.title: LUSTRE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length couture look is composed of a structured corset and a fluid crepe skirt. The corset is shaped with fine pleating in a soft aqua tone, forming a shell-like structure executed in tulle and reinforced through hand embroidery. Sequins, beads, and crystals are applied in controlled gradations of turquoise and lilac, creating a concentrated surface sheen along the bodice.

 

The crepe skirt is constructed from elongated ivory panels that open vertically, handcrafted by a team of six skilled couturiers over 650 hours, the piece reflects couture defined by precision, surface control, and sculptural balance.

products.title: SIREN GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length ball gown is constructed from layered fine tulle, creating structured volume through lightness. The bodice forms a shell-shaped motif, executed with dense hand embroidery of crystals, sequins, beads, and pearls arranged in precise radiating lines that extend downward across the skirt. Soft tonal transitions of ivory, pink, and pale blue enhance depth within the embroidery.

 

A separately embroidered bolero frames the shoulders, echoing the same embroidery language. Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision.

products.title: REVERIE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from crepe in a soft blush pink tone, defined by a fluid silhouette layered with soft tulle. The design unfolds in tiered levels, each edged with delicate hand embroidery arranged in subtle gradations of purple and blue. The embellishment remains concentrated along the hems, creating a shifting shimmer that moves in soft, wave-like rhythms with each step, allowing the layered tulle to move freely.

 

Handcrafted by a team of six skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by lightness, precision, and controlled motion.

products.title: PEARLETTE GOWN
products.body_html:
This couture look is composed of a floor-length crepe skirt and a delicately hand-embroidered cropped top. The top is worked with crystals, sequins, beads, and pearls arranged in natural shell-inspired gradations, forming a luminous surface that defines the upper body with clarity. The skirt falls in a clean, elongated line, maintaining structure through restraint.

The look is completed by a sculptural three-dimensional shell element, crafted from liquid taffeta and embroidered with natural pearls. Attached to the body, it wraps around the arm and extends to the floor as an integral structural component of the design. 


Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 700 hours, the piece reflects couture defined by surface mastery and sculptural construction.

products.title: SEAWISP GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length halter gown is crafted from lightweight aquamarine crepe. Sophisticated hand embroidery of sequins and beads is arranged in radiating lines from the neckline and waist, establishing a clear visual rhythm across the body. From the waist, elongated handmade beaded fringe extends over the skirt, creating a luminous, continuous movement that becomes more pronounced with each step.

 

Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision, controlled motion, and material discipline.

products.title: WAVELET GOWN
products.body_html:

The neckline follows a softly curved, wave-like line, delicately hand-embroidered with sequins and crystals along the upper edge. From the waist, the fabric opens into a full skirt with a clear, structured shape.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

products.title: TIDAL GOWN
products.body_html:
This aquamarine gown is crafted from mikado silk and defined by a structured corseted bodice that shapes the silhouette with clarity. The neckline follows a shell-like curve, delicately hand-embroidered with pearls, sequins, and crystals along the upper edge. A draped twist at the hip introduces controlled movement, from which the fabric extends into a clean column skirt finished with a soft trailing train.

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 500 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by precision of cut, material control, and balanced proportion.

products.title: YAMM GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length aquamarine gown is crafted from finely worked dentelle and defined by a fitted, elongated silhouette. The off-shoulder neckline opens the upper frame, while the long sleeves are integrated into the lace structure, extending the line of the body. The transparency of the dentelle allows the embroidery to remain visually present across the surface.

 

Handcrafted by a team of five skilled couturiers over 600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface precision, disciplined execution, and balanced proportion.

products.title: PEARLY GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is crafted from sheer ivory dentelle, featuring hand-embroidered detailing integrated into the surface. From the neckline, vertical strands of natural pearl fringes extend across the gown, introducing movement that becomes more pronounced with each step. The pearls interact with the transparency of the lace, creating a layered visual rhythm.

 

Handcrafted by a team of seven skilled couturiers over 900 hours, the gown reflects couture built on material expression, precision, and a considered approach to transparency.

products.title: MOTHER PEARL GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless, floor-length gown is defined by a straight column silhouette and a bodice constructed from hand-carved mother-of-pearl laminate. Each tile is cut, polished, and assembled to form a continuous, iridescent surface that reflects light through the natural properties of the material. The bodice establishes the visual identity and weight of the piece with clarity and precision.

 

From the waist, vertical strands of natural pearls and hand-set crystal droplets descend over chiffon, introducing controlled luminous movement in contrast to the structured upper form. Handcrafted by a team of ten skilled couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by material mastery, precision, and permanence.

products.title: NACRE GOWN
products.body_html:
This strapless, floor-length gown is defined by a straight column silhouette and a fully hand-embroidered surface. The surface is entirely worked with hand-cut mother-of-pearl tiles, faceted crystals, and natural pearls, assembled into a dense, reflective field that captures and returns light with controlled intensity. The embroidery establishes the visual identity of the piece while maintaining a continuous vertical line.


A sheer tulle cape veil extends from the head and shoulders, introducing fluid movement in contrast to the structured silhouette. Handcrafted by a team of ten couturiers over 1,600 hours, the gown reflects couture defined by surface mastery.

products.title: LIORE GOWN
products.body_html:
This floor-length gown is defined by a commanding, fully hand-embroidered surface that shapes the identity of the piece. The high-neck bodice is worked with hand-cut mother-of-pearl elements, faceted crystals, and natural pearls, assembled to form a dense, luminous surface that captures and reflects light with clarity. The embroidery establishes the visual weight of the gown while articulating the upper body through precision.

 

From the bodice, fluid chiffon panels extend downward, opening the silhouette into movement. Handcrafted by seven skilled couturiers over 1,200 hours, the gown embodies couture defined by surface mastery, material discipline, and enduring presence beyond season and trend.

products.title: Burgundy gown
products.body_html: A strapless burgundy gown with an elegant A-line silhouette, crafted from luxurious crepe fabric. Featuring a corset construction for structure and a velvet scarf for a regal touch, the gown is accented with intricate hand embroidery along the neckline. This design is the result of over 300 hours of meticulous craftsmanship by a team of ten expert couturiers, embodying the essence of timeless couture.

This halterneck gown is finely tailored from luminous satin in a svelte ankle-length cut finishing with a scalloped  hem. Extending from the waist is an elaborate gathered train, its delicate folds meticulously shaped and stitched by hand to mimic the soft curves of petals. This recurring floral motif, which is seen throughout the collection as a symbol of resilience and renewal, is replicated here in waves of glistening flower motifs, which adorn the lower skirt and train. Every element of this gown is  handcrafted by a team of talented couturiers, who devote over 300 hours to its creation.

products.title: Fleur GOWN
products.body_html: A luminous creation designed in partnership with Zahra Breast Cancer Association, Lune radiates powerful femininity and  sophistication. The sylphlike silhouette is formed from lustrous ivory crepe, which is sculpted at the neckline with two exquisite lotuses. The sensitivity and beauty of the design not only testifies to the craftsmanship and vision of Waad Aloqaili, but serves as a fitting tribute to women throughout the world living with breast cancer.

products.title: Emeralds GOWN
products.body_html: Emeralds is a striking mermaid gown that exudes sophistication and modern femininity. Crafted from flowing emerald-green crepe, the dress is expertly tailored to trace the body’s silhouette, cascading into a dramatic floor-length skirt. A glistening dragonfly, formed from a myriad of beads, sequins and crystals, rests delicately on the gown, symbolizing transformation and renewal. Every intricate detail testifies to the dedication of Waad Aloqaili couturiers who invest 350 hours to bring this masterpiece to life.

products.title: Lune GOWN
products.body_html: A luminous creation designed in partnership with Zahra Breast Cancer Association, Lune radiates powerful femininity and  sophistication. The sylphlike silhouette is formed from lustrous ivory crepe, which is sculpted at the neckline with two exquisite lotuses. The sensitivity and beauty of the design not only testifies to the craftsmanship and vision of Waad Aloqaili, but serves as a fitting tribute to women throughout the world living with breast cancer.

products.title: Garden of delight GOWN
products.body_html: Created in partnership with Zahra Breast Cancer Association,Garden of Delight emanates timeless elegance and feminine strength. Luminous silks and tulle are expertly tailored to form a billowing skirt and strapless bodice, shaped at the neckline with two lotus flowers that symbolize renewal and purity. Lustrous threads, gemstones, sequins, and beads enrich the floral design, catching the light with every movement. A team of artisans dedicate over 400 hours to perfect the gown’s ageless ballgown silhouette and exquisite adornment.

products.title: MOONLIT GOWN
products.body_html: With streams of lustrous adornment and a slender silhouette, Moonlit is the epitome of timeless elegance. Thousands of hand-sewn sequins, beads and gems mimic the shimmering wings of the magnificent dragonfly—a powerful symbol of transformation and rebirth. Gossamer layers of georgette and tulle are skillfully hand-shaped to form a demure high neck, sensual mermaid skirt and billowing, wing-like cape. A team of consummate artisans craft every element of the design over the course of 800 hours.

products.title: GOLDEN DEW GOWN
products.body_html: Flooded with glistening beads, sequins and crystals, Golden Dew is an ode to the artistry of couture. Meticulously tailored to the contours of the body, the gown falls to the floor with a classic mermaid skirt and features elegant gloved sleeves. Drawing on powerful symbolism of the enigmatic dragonfly, the dress features a wing shaped cut-out at the waist, which extends to form a dramatic plunge neckline. Additional cut-outs at the back mirror this evocative motif. Skillful couturiers finesse every stitch, fold and cut over the course of 800 hours to ensure an impeccable finish.

products.title: GLIDE GOWN
products.body_html: Capturing an air of quiet dynamism and timeless grace, Glide is the culmination of over 700 hours of couture craftsmanship and masterful design. Echoing the brilliance of the dragonfly, reams of jewel-green crepe are expertly tailored by a team of artisans to form a fitted bodice and spliced mermaid skirt. Two straps, that tumble from the shoulder, feature elegant wing motifs composed of a myriad of beads, sequins and crystals.

products.title: ORCHID GOWN
products.body_html: Orchid is a luminous full-length gown that combines opulence with exemplary craftsmanship. Lustrous satin, chiffon and tulle are carefully manipulated by hand to form delicate, undulating folds that gently embrace the figure and stream to the floor, evoking the organic, sinuous form of flowers. Beads, sequins and crystals, each one meticulously sewn by hand adorn each fine pleat, creating a perpetual shimmer. A team of ten talented couturiers spend a total of 300 hours handcrafting every contour and artistic element of this captivating creation.

Reams of black crepe, draped to perfection by skilled dressmakers, follow the natural curves of the body and finish in a dramatic mermaid train. Wing-shaped shoulder cut-outs and bejeweled gloved sleeves allude to the rarely seen wings of a dragonfly-an evocative motif that weaves throughout the collection, symbolizing rebirth and transformation. An exemplary team of ten talented couturiers pour their expertise, talent and passion into creating this exceptional design over the course of 300 hours.

This enchanting couture creation is formed over the course of 300 hours by a team of dedicated dressmakers and artisans.
